levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري

notes: «أَخِيهِ عمر» is one link named by the name alone («عمر»), per rule 7.
«أَبي الحَسَن» follows «عَنْ», so the Imam stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); his words are the saying.
The blessing after «أبي‏رحمه الله» is not part of the surface.
